scope: One final inverse-DCT sample-conversion primitive; two frozen JPEG inputs from one original 513x259 raster. Single CPU warm public decode to independent RGBA8. No uniform parity claim.
changedPrimitive: On AVX-512F/VL, normalize the eight independent row sums with separate exact power-of-two multiplication and addition; clip finite samples to [0,255], floor, add one only when the exact fractional part is at least one half, then safely narrow/copy eight bytes. This preserves away-from-zero rounding including immediately below half ties. Original accumulation, basis, work/admission, AVX and scalar fallbacks remain unchanged. No FMA, reassociation, new storage, allocation or cache.
